# DNS resolution (`source_type: dns`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-probe-refs.ts from packages/probe-config. Do not edit by hand. -->

Resolves a name and reports the resolve time in milliseconds.

- Runs on: an Observer Agent (set the metric's `agent` to its name)
- Thresholds: required when the metric is created (all four fields)
- testProbe: supported

## Value and unit

- `ms`: DNS resolve time in milliseconds

## source_config fields

| Field | Required | Type | Default | Limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `domain` | yes | string |  |  |
| `record_type` | no | enum | `"A"` | `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT`, `NS`, `SRV`, `CAA`, `PTR` |
| `expected_value` | no | string |  |  |
| `resolver` | no | string |  |  |
| `timeout_ms` | no | integer | `5000` | 1 to 60000 |

## Rules

- `expected_value` makes the check fail when the answer does not contain it.
- `resolver` sends the query to a specific DNS server instead of the host's default.

## Example

```yaml
source_type: dns
source_config: {"domain":"api.example.com","record_type":"A"}
```
